$comment: Descriptions for props whose types carry none, used in each page's API reference. Keys are `Part.prop` or a bare `prop` for every part. null hides a prop that is internal plumbing.
items: The items as data. Pass a function as the child to render each one.
Accordion.value: The values of the open items. Pass it to control the accordion.
Accordion.defaultValue: The items open at first, when uncontrolled.
Accordion.onValueChange: Runs when an item opens or closes, with the values of the open items.
Accordion.multiple: Whether more than one item can be open at a time.
Accordion.collapsible: Whether the open item can be closed again when only one can be open.
Accordion.keepMounted: Keeps closed panels in the page, hidden.
Accordion.hiddenUntilFound: Hides closed panels with `hidden="until-found"`, so the browser's find in page can open them.
Accordion.controller: Opens and closes items from anywhere.
Tabs.value: The selected tab's value. Pass it to control the tabs.
Tabs.defaultValue: The tab selected at first, when uncontrolled.
Tabs.onValueChange: Runs when another tab is selected.
Tabs.orientation: `"horizontal"` or `"vertical"`: which arrow keys move between tabs.
Tabs.activation: `"automatic"` selects a tab as focus reaches it. `"manual"` waits for Enter or Space.
Tabs.loop: Whether the arrow keys wrap from the last tab to the first.
Tabs.hiddenUntilFound: Hides inactive panels with `hidden="until-found"`, so the browser's find in page can open them.
Tabs.controller: Selects and focuses tabs from anywhere.
Avatar.fallbackDelay: How long to wait, in ms, before showing the fallback while the image loads.
DrawerClose.action: Runs when pressed, before the drawer closes. Return a promise to keep it open, pending, until it settles.
DrawerClose.value: Passed to `onOpenChange` as `details.returnValue` when this closes the drawer.
MotionStyle.preference: The preference to read and set. Defaults to the shared motion style, saved for the whole site.
MotionStyleSwitcher.preference: The preference to read and set. Defaults to the shared motion style, saved for the whole site.
SidebarGroup.defaultOpen: Whether a collapsible group starts open, when uncontrolled.
SidebarGroup.open: Whether a collapsible group is open. Pass it to control the group.
SidebarGroup.onOpenChange: Runs when a collapsible group opens or closes.
SidebarMenuButton.href: Renders the item as a link to this address.
SkeletonSwap.loading: Whether the skeleton shows instead of the content.
SkeletonSwap.fallback: What shows while loading. Defaults to a skeleton block the size of the content.
ToastIcon.type: Which icon to draw. Match it to the toast's type.
PaginationRoll.value: The page number to show. It rolls to each new value.
TreeGroup.value: The value of the item this group belongs to.
TimelineConnector.status: Overrides the status this part takes from its item.
TimelineDescription.status: Overrides the status this part takes from its item.
TimelineMarker.status: Overrides the status this part takes from its item.
TimelineTime.status: Overrides the status this part takes from its item.
TimelineTitle.status: Overrides the status this part takes from its item.
useSidebar.collapsed: Whether the sidebar is narrowed to the icon rail.
useSidebar.setCollapsed: Narrows the sidebar to the rail, or widens it.
useSidebar.isMobile: Whether the provider is below `mobileBreakpoint`, so the sidebar is a sheet.
useSidebar.openMobile: Whether the sheet is open, on a phone.
useSidebar: Reads and changes the sidebar's state from any component inside `SidebarProvider`, like your own trigger in the page header.
useFieldControl: Connects a control of your own to the field it sits in, so the label, description and error message point at it.
